tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The ground everything sits on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, agent nodes, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Meter tracks, code blocks, inset wells, table header rows.

tokens.name: surface-embed
tokens.usage: Background of MCP App widgets rendered inside a host chat: transparent, so the host's own background shows through. Inner cards still use surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (decorative, not meaningful).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and tree connectors. 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, units (USDC), labels and timestamps on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: Brand colour. Primary actions, the mark, active budgets, spent amounts in meters. Legible as text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-verdigris
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a verdigris fill. Never use literal white in Basalt.

tokens.name: verdigris-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind active badges and selected tree nodes; verdigris text reads on it.

tokens.name: aurum
tokens.usage: Money and reservations: reserved amounts, the reserved meter segment, focus ring. Legible as text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: aurum-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind reserved badges; aurum text reads on it.

tokens.name: cinnabar
tokens.usage: Rejected transactions, exceeded limits, destructive actions. Legible as text on surface and surface-raised. Never decorative.

tokens.name: cinnabar-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind rejected badges and rejection log rows; cinnabar text reads on it.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Frozen branches and paused agents. Legible as text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: frost-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind frozen badges and frozen subtrees; frost text reads on it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Every agent answers to a budget.
styles.usage: Hero lines on the landing page, pitch slides, demo title cards. One per view.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles in the dashboard and docs.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Roman depth numerals I–IV on agent nodes and tree levels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The research agent delegated 40 USDC to two subagents.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, badge text, table headers. Always uppercase.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts inside nodes, tables and logs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls; base unit of the grid.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between related items in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards; tree level indent.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop, section breaks on the landing page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, meter bars, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, agent nodes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and large surfaces only.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals and popovers only. Cards use line borders, never shadows.
